sents.zh: 山里有一条河，河里住着很多龙。
sents.en: There was a river in the mountains, and many dragons lived in it.

sents.zh: 其中有一条小龙，它还不会游泳。
sents.en: Among them was a little dragon who could not yet swim.

sents.zh: 每天早上，它都坐在河边看别的龙。
sents.en: Every morning it sat by the river and watched the other dragons.

sents.zh: 别的龙在水里又跳又玩，看起来很快乐。
sents.en: The others leapt and played in the water, and looked very happy.

sents.zh: 小龙也想下去，但是它不敢。
sents.en: Little Dragon wanted to go in too, but did not dare.

sents.zh: 因为水又大又冷，所以它一直坐在那里。
sents.en: Because the water was deep and cold, it kept sitting there.

sents.zh: 妈妈问它：“你为什么不下来呢？”
sents.en: Its mother asked: "Why don’t you come in?"

sents.zh: 小龙说：“我不敢。如果我下去，会不会不好？”
sents.en: Little Dragon said: "I don’t dare. If I go in, will something bad happen?"

sents.zh: 妈妈说：“你先看我，我教你。”
sents.en: Its mother said: "Watch me first — I will teach you."

sents.zh: 然后妈妈在水里慢慢地游给它看。
sents.en: Then its mother swam slowly in the water for it to see.

sents.zh: 小龙看了很久，最后也进了水里。
sents.en: Little Dragon watched for a long time, and at last went into the water too.

sents.zh: 第一次它做得不好，头都进了水里。
sents.en: The first time it did not do well, and its head went under the water.

sents.zh: 虽然这样，它还是又试了一次，又一次。
sents.en: Even so, it tried again, and again.

sents.zh: 到了下午，它已经可以游到河的那一边了。
sents.en: By the afternoon it could already swim to the other side of the river.

sents.zh: 妈妈说：“你看，你自己做到了。”
sents.en: Its mother said: "You see — you did it yourself."
